item.title: Tsitsipas Makes a Key Decision in His Tennis Career
item.description: Stefanos Tsitsipas is making a major change ahead of the 2026 season by switching from his longtime Wilson racket to the Babolat Pure Aero 98, the same model he successfully tested (blacked-out) during his Dubai title win in 2025. The Greek star hopes this move will boost power on his backhand, reduce injury risks, and help him return to the top elite after a challenging year. item.title: Egypt, Turkey, Somalia, and Djibouti Reject Israel's Recognition of Somaliland
item.description: Israel has become the first country to formally recognize Somaliland as an independent sovereign state, signing a mutual declaration with its president on December 26, 2025. The move, framed in the spirit of the Abraham Accords, has drawn strong condemnation from Egypt, Turkey, Somalia, and Djibouti, who reaffirm their support for Somalia's unity and territorial integrity.
